description: A place in the person's life, such as Home or Grandma's house: one they saved and named, or one LogDate suggested from where they spend time.

main.description:
A place in the person's life, such as Home or Grandma's house: one they saved and named, or one LogDate suggested from where they spend time. A suggestion becomes the person's own once they confirm it.

Today the apps keep a place in two tables that share its id: the places the person saved (with a radius, a description and timestamps) and the places in their location history (with an address, a map directory id and whether it's confirmed). This record is both: one record per id, with every field from either. When both have a value, the saved place's name, coordinates and radius win, because renaming or moving a saved place changes it in place and so holds the person's latest choice. Label corrections can change the name shown. Take the app.logdate.place.correction records with field label that target place:<this record's key> and that no other correction lists in supersedes. If there are none, show name. If they all give the same label, show that label and treat the place as confirmed. If they disagree, show name and offer the person the disagreeing corrections as a conflict to settle. Corrections are never ordered by time, because many have no createdAt. Deleting this record deletes the place from both: there is no way to delete one without the other.

name.description: The place's name. The app doesn't limit its length, so the limit matches an entry's text block.

radiusCentimeters.description: How far from the center still counts as being at the place, in centimeters: the saved radius in meters times 100, rounded to the nearest whole number, and 0 if it was negative. There's no upper limit, because the app sets none. When absent, apps use their usual distance for telling whether someone stayed somewhere.

locality.description: A readable description of where the place is, such as its street address or neighborhood, as the map directory gave it.

externalId.description: The place's identifier in the map directory it was suggested from, used to recognize the same place when it's suggested again.

userConfirmed.description: True when the person saved or confirmed the place, false while it's only a suggestion. Defaults to false. A place the person saved is always confirmed.

createdAt.description: When the person saved the place. Absent for places that only ever came from location history, which doesn't record it.
